articles.description: Sánchez was named a NL Cy Young finalist, while closer Duran was considered for Reliever of the Year Award and Mattingly was added as a finalist for Manager of the Year.
articles.title: Phillies’ Cristopher Sanchez, Jhoan Duran and Don Mattingly named finalists for MLB awards

articles.description: MLB is proposing a cap of $258.2 million with a $180.2 million floor, figures that were amended from its initial offers of $245.3 million and $171.2 million. The players’ union rejected the offer.
articles.title: MLB’s proposal to ‘phase in’ salary cap and floor could have implications on Phillies

articles.description: Fatse has spent his entire career watching the Phillies from afar. Now, with a lockout looming, he won’t have long to make an impact.
articles.title: New Phillies hitting coach Peter Fatse brings experience with stars and analytics, but he’s already short on time

articles.description: As the Phillies' representative in the players' union, Garrett Stubbs is on the front lines of baseball's upcoming labor dispute. He joined "Phillies Extra" to discuss the CBA and the next season.
articles.title: Phillies Extra: Garrett Stubbs on baseball’s looming labor fight, the case against a salary cap, and more

articles.description: The Phillies president arrived in 2020 to much fanfare, but Dealin’ Dave's moves in Philly have been mostly misses. He can't afford any more.
articles.title: Hot stove season begins. Will Dave Dombrowski make more mistakes like Pete Alonso, Trea Turner, José Alvarado?
